about: Fibre network model for the site map: cables, enclosures (panels, devices) and what is joined to what inside each one. Splice and trace diagrams on natm.github.io/map are drawn from this file, and scripts/fibre-network.py writes the Mermaid path diagrams in fibre.md from it. Format: map/README.md#fibre-network. PUBLIC: no VLANs, switch ports or IP addresses.

SHED.name: Shed rack
SHED.notes: F03 leaves MH10 into the shed rack, where all 24 cores are spliced to LC connectors on a 1U patch panel (Nat, 2026-11-06). Port numbers, and the patching to F08 (from the barn) and F02 (to the snug), are not yet recorded.

WOODS.name: Woods cabinet
WOODS.where: Grey outdoor 19-inch cabinet on a concrete plinth next to MH12 and a pole in the woods, with a galvanised box beside it ("pole in woods" on the 2 The Cottage label). Photos 2026-11-06.
WOODS.notes: Nat on site, 2026-11-06: F04 fibres 5-8 are patched to F03 fibres 5-8 (LC 5-8 to LC 40-43). F03 fibre 3 (LC 38) carries a 1G BiDi circuit from here to the barn, into the media converter, which feeds the UniFi Flex switch. Media converter and Flex switch powered up. Port numbers are our own (F04 on LC 1-8, F03 on LC 36-59), not the numbers printed on the 48-port panel (Nat: ignore those). Not stated: what LC 1-4 (F04 fibres 1-4) are patched to, so the Ty Di rif circuit (F04 fibre 1) stops here.
